submissions.title: Resources for IGCSE students
submissions.description:
What's it for?
This project is an online repository designed to provide high-quality, free resources for students preparing for their IGCSE examinations. It helps students access past papers, structured revision notes, and interactive quizzes across various subjects like Mathematics, Physics, Chemistry, and Computer Science to help them boost their grades.
• What was hard?
The most challenging part was:
	• Database structuring: Organizing a vast amount of syllabus materials, notes, and past papers by year, variant, and subject in a way that remains intuitive for users.
What you're proud of:
I am proud of creating a clean, distraction-free user interface that allows students to find exactly what they need in fewer than three clicks. Building a working search filter that instantly sorts resources by subject and paper variant was a major milestone for this project.
